references.text: Continuation of the instructions regarding fragrant spices for incense to be used in the sanctuary
The list of materials for the tabernacle includes spices for the anointing oil and fragrant incense
Bezalel made the holy anointing oil and the pure fragrant incense
Song of Songs mentions cinnamon (קִנָּמוֹן) among fragrant spices
Proverbs mention myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon as fragrant spices
Ezekiel mentions cinnamon and calamus in connection with trade with Tyre
Revelation mentions cinnamon (κινάμωμον) among Babylon's merchandise
Describes the people giving the specific spices mentioned in Exodus 30:23 for use in the temple.
Restating the link between the recipe in chapter 30 and the offering in chapter 35.
